title: 8 Million Degrees Hotter Than Earth? The Sun’s Corona Myth Busted

scenes.text: 8 million degrees hotter than Earth's surface, yet people think the Sun’s corona is cooler.
People often believe the Sun’s outer atmosphere, the corona, is cooler than the surface.
scenes.label: Corona Cooler Myth

scenes.text: In fact, the corona reaches temperatures over 1 million Kelvin, far hotter than the Sun’s visible surface at about 5,800 K.
scenes.label: Corona is Hotter

scenes.text: The Sun’s outer layer is a million degrees hotter than its surface because of magnetic heating.
scenes.label: Magnetic Heating

scenes.text: Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: The Sun’s corona is actually millions of degrees hotter than its surface, defying common belief. Follow for daily science!
